sentences.text: The Amazon rainforest is home to countless wild species.
Many scientists study how creatures survive in the dense jungle.
Poison dart frogs are known to be venomous, which means they produce a toxic substance that can harm predators.
Their bright blue and yellow skin warns other animals to stay away.
Even a tiny touch of their skin can make an attacker very sick.

challenges.correctMeaning: Producing poison that can harm other animals
meaningOptions: Producing poison that can harm other animals
Able to change colors to hide from enemies
Moving very quickly through the trees
challenges.dictionaryDefinition: Capable of injecting venom or poison by means of a bite or sting.

sentences.text: Life high up in the rainforest canopy is full of daily challenges.
Spider monkeys travel effortlessly through the upper branches.
Sloths move at a sluggish pace, defined as an extremely slow speed.
It can take a sloth several minutes to travel just a few feet.
Algae often grows on their fur, giving them a greenish color.
Rainforest birds come in many different shapes and sizes.
The toucan is famous for its large beak.
Macaws are gregarious birds, which is a way of saying they live and travel in large, noisy flocks.
You will rarely see a single macaw flying alone through the trees.
Their colorful feathers flash brilliantly against the green leaves.

challenges.correctMeaning: Living and traveling together in groups
meaningOptions: Living and traveling together in groups
